memories.summary: As of 2026-09-05 Mara's mother is well and her cardiologist cleared her to travel short distances; she is talking about visiting Toronto for Christmas 2026.
Dr. Tunde Adeyemi, the family-friend doctor, signed off on Mara's mother being stable enough to travel to Toronto; Mara calls him a quiet anchor through the whole ordeal.

entities.name: Dr. Tunde Adeyemi
entities.description: family-friend doctor who looks in on Mara's mother; distinct from uncle Tunde Bakare

memories.summary: Mara's interview for the permanent ICU position was scheduled for Tuesday 2026-09-08.
Mara said (2026-09-05) she would carry her mother to Toronto herself for a Christmas visit if needed, gladly hosting her.
